name: DevCycle JS SDKs
solves: Provides client-side and server-side feature flag management SDKs for JavaScript, React, React Native, Next.js, Node.js, and NestJS, enabling real-time feature toggling with local bucketing and OpenFeature compatibility.
best_for: Full-stack JavaScript projects needing feature flags across client, server, and mobile from one vendor
React or Next.js apps requiring real-time feature flag updates with SSE streaming
Teams wanting OpenFeature-compatible feature flags with migration strategies for gradual adoption
NestJS applications needing dependency-injected feature flag management
React Native and Expo mobile apps requiring cross-platform feature flag support
skip_when: You need a fully self-hosted or open-source feature flag solution without vendor dependency
Your stack is primarily Python, Go, or non-JavaScript and you want a single unified SDK
You want a free feature flag service with no usage limits — DevCycle is a commercial SaaS product
You only need simple boolean toggles and want zero external dependencies or API calls
Your project requires on-premise deployment with no external network calls
